title: नवनवतितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 99 · The merit of groves and tanks

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks for the fruit of planting groves and digging tanks. Bhishma says that one whose tank holds water in the cold season wins the fruit of a great sacrifice, and teaches that there are six kinds of unmoving beings, trees, shrubs, creepers and others, who feel and so a man should plant trees and dig a tank and speak the truth.
summary.kn: ತೋಪು ನೆಡುವ, ಕೆರೆ ತೋಡುವ ಫಲ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೇಮಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಿರುವ ಕೆರೆಯವನಿಗೆ ಮಹಾ ಯಜ್ಞದ ಫಲ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಮರ, ಪೊದೆ, ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಮೊದಲಾದ ಆರು ಸ್ಥಾವರ ಜಾತಿಗಳು ಅನುಭವಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಕೆರೆ ತೋಡಿ ಮರ ನೆಡಿ ಸತ್ಯ ಹೇಳಬೇಕೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर उद्यान लगाने और तालाब खुदवाने का फल पूछते हैं। भीष्म कहते हैं कि जिसके तालाब में हेमन्त में जल रहता है उसे महान यज्ञ का फल मिलता है, और सिखाते हैं कि वृक्ष, झाड़ी, लता आदि छह प्रकार के स्थावर प्राणी अनुभव करते हैं, इसलिए तालाब खुदवाओ, वृक्ष लगाओ और सत्य बोलो।
summary.te: తోటలు నాటడం, చెరువులు తవ్వడం ఫలం గురించి యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. హేమంతంలో నీరుండే చెరువు గలవాడు గొప్ప యజ్ఞ ఫలం పొందుతాడని, చెట్లు, పొదలు, తీగలు వంటి ఆరు రకాల స్థావరాలు అనుభూతి చెందుతాయని, కాబట్టి చెరువు తవ్వి చెట్లు నాటి సత్యం పలకాలని భీష్ముడు బోధిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தோப்புகள் நடுவதும் குளம் வெட்டுவதும் தரும் பலனை யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, முன்பனிக்காலத்தில் நீருள்ள குளத்தை உடையவன் பெரிய வேள்வியின் பலன் பெறுவான், மரம், புதர், கொடி போன்ற ஆறு வகை அசையாதவை உணர்கின்றன, ஆகவே குளம் வெட்டி மரம் நட்டு உண்மை பேச வேண்டும் என்று பீஷ்மர் போதிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: തോപ്പുകൾ വെച്ചുപിടിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിന്റെയും കുളങ്ങൾ കുഴിക്കുന്നതിന്റെയും ഫലം യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. തണുപ്പുകാലത്ത് വെള്ളം നിലനിൽക്കുന്ന കുളം കുഴിക്കുന്നവന് വലിയ യാഗത്തിന്റെ ഫലം ലഭിക്കുമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; വൃക്ഷങ്ങൾ, കുറ്റിച്ചെടികൾ, വള്ളിച്ചെടികൾ എന്നിങ്ങനെ ചലനമില്ലാത്ത ആറു തരം ജീവികൾക്ക് അനുഭൂതിയുണ്ടെന്നും, അതിനാൽ മനുഷ്യൻ മരം നടുകയും കുളം കുഴിക്കുകയും സത്യം പറയുകയും വേണമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.99; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
आरामाणां तडागानां यत्फलं कुरुनन्दन ।
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तोऽद्य भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Joy of the Kurus, I wish to hear from you today the reward of groves and of tanks, best of Bharatas.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
सुप्रदर्शा वनवती चित्रधातुविभूषिता ।
उपेता सर्वबीजैश्च श्रेष्ठा भूमिरिहोच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Land that is fair to look at, wooded, adorned with varied minerals and fit for all seeds is said here to be the best.

verses.text:
तस्याः क्षेत्रविशेषं च तडागानां निवेशनम् ।
औदकानि च सर्वाणि प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: I will tell you in order about the special kinds of site, the placing of tanks, and everything to do with water.

verses.text:
तडागानां च वक्ष्यामि कृतानां चापि ये गुणाः ।
त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वत्र पूजितो यस्तडागवान् ॥

meaning.en: I will tell the merits of tanks and of those made; he who owns a tank is honoured everywhere in the three worlds.

verses.text:
अथ वा मित्रसदनं मैत्रं मित्रविवर्धनम् ।
कीर्तिसंजननं श्रेष्ठं तडागानां निवेशनम् ॥

meaning.en: A tank is a home for friends, a friendly thing that increases friends and brings fame; the siting of tanks is the best of deeds.

verses.text:
धर्मस्यार्थस्य कामस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः ।
तडागं सुकृतं देशे क्षेत्रमेव महाश्रयम् ॥

meaning.en: The wise say a well-made tank in a good place yields the reward of dharma, wealth and desire, and is a great refuge, like a field.

verses.text:
चतुर्विधानां भूतानां तडागमुपलक्षयेत् ।
तडागानि च सर्वाणि दिशन्ति श्रियमुत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: A tank should be seen as serving the four kinds of beings, and all tanks bestow supreme prosperity.

verses.text:
देवा मनुष्या गन्धर्वाः पितरोरगराक्षसाः ।
स्थावराणि च भूतानि संश्रयन्ति जलाशयम् ॥

meaning.en: Gods, men, gandharvas, ancestors, serpents and rakshasas, and the unmoving beings, all take shelter at a reservoir.

verses.text:
तस्मात्तांस्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तडागे ये गुणाः स्मृताः ।
या च तत्र फलावाप्तिरृषिभिः समुदाहृता ॥

meaning.en: So I will tell you the merits said to belong to a tank and the reward the sages have declared for it.

verses.text:
वर्षमात्रे तडागे तु सलिलं यस्य तिष्ठति ।
अग्निहोत्रफलं तस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: He in whose tank water remains through the rains alone receives, say the wise, the reward of the agnihotra.

verses.text:
शरत्काले तु सलिलं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति ।
गोसहस्रस्य स प्रेत्य लभते फलमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: He in whose tank water remains in autumn gains after death the supreme reward of a thousand cows.

verses.text:
हेमन्तकाले सलिलं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति ।
स वै बहुसुवर्णस्य यज्ञस्य लभते फलम् ॥

meaning.en: He in whose tank water remains in the cool season gains the reward of a sacrifice with much gold.

verses.text:
यस्य वै शैशिरे काले तडागे सलिलं भवेत् ।
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wise say that he whose tank has water in the dewy season gains the reward of the Agnishtoma sacrifice.

verses.text:
तडागं सुकृतं यस्य वसन्ते तु महाश्रयम् ।
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं स समुपाश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: He whose well-made tank is a great refuge in spring gains the reward of the Atiratra sacrifice.

verses.text:
निदाघकाले पानीयं तडागे यस्य तिष्ठति ।
वाजपेयसमं तस्य फलं वै मुनयो विदुः ॥

meaning.en: The sages know that he whose tank has drinking water in the hot season gains a reward equal to the Vajapeya.

verses.text:
स कुलं तारयेत्सर्वं यस्य खाते जलाशये ।
गावः पिबन्ति पानीयं साधवश्च नराः सदा ॥

meaning.en: He saves his whole family in whose dug reservoir cows and good men always drink water.

verses.text:
तडागे यस्य गावस्तु पिबन्ति तृषिता जलम् ।
मृगपक्षिमनुष्याश्च सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥

meaning.en: He in whose tank thirsty cows, animals, birds and men drink water gains the reward of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
यत्पिबन्ति जलं तत्र स्नायन्ते विश्रमन्ति च ।
तडागदस्य तत्सर्वं प्रेत्यानन्त्याय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: All that people drink there, and in which they bathe and rest, becomes endless for the giver of the tank after death.

verses.text:
दुर्लभं सलिलं तात विशेषेण परत्र वै ।
पानीयस्य प्रदानेन प्रीतिर्भवति शाश्वती ॥

meaning.en: Water, dear one, is hard to get, especially in the next world; by giving drinking water lasting joy arises.

verses.text:
तिलान्ददत पानीयं दीपान्ददत जाग्रत ।
ज्ञातिभिः सह मोदध्वमेतत्प्रेतेषु दुर्लभम् ॥

meaning.en: Give sesame and water, give lamps, and stay awake; rejoice with your kin; this is hard to obtain among the dead.

verses.text:
सर्वदानैर्गुरुतरं सर्वदानैर्विशिष्यते ।
पानीयं नरशार्दूल तस्माद्दातव्यमेव हि ॥

meaning.en: It is weightier than all gifts and surpasses all gifts, tiger among men; therefore water ought to be given.

verses.text:
एवमेतत्तडागेषु कीर्तितं फलमुत्तमम् ।
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वृक्षाणामपि रोपणे ॥

meaning.en: Thus the supreme reward of tanks has been told; now I will speak of planting trees.

verses.text:
स्थावराणां च भूतानां जातयः षट्प्रकीर्तिताः ।
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्ल्यस्त्वक्सारास्तृणजातयः ॥

meaning.en: Six kinds of unmoving beings are declared: trees, shrubs, creepers, vines, those with bark for their essence, and grasses.

verses.text:
एता जात्यस्तु वृक्षाणां तेषां रोपे गुणास्त्विमे ।
कीर्तिश्च मानुषे लोके प्रेत्य चैव फलं शुभम् ॥

meaning.en: These are the classes of trees; these are the merits of planting them: fame in the world of men and a good reward after death.

verses.text:
लभते नाम लोके च पितृभिश्च महीयते ।
देवलोकगतस्यापि नाम तस्य न नश्यति ॥

meaning.en: He wins renown in the world and is honoured by the ancestors; even when he has gone to the world of the gods, his name does not perish.

verses.text:
अतीतानागते चोभे पितृवंशं च भारत ।
तारयेद्वृक्षरोपी च तस्माद्वृक्षान्प्ररोपयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, one who plants trees saves both the past and future of his father's line; therefore one should plant trees.

verses.text:
तस्य पुत्रा भवन्त्येते पादपा नात्र संशयः ।
परलोकगतः स्वर्गं लोकांश्चाप्नोति सोऽव्ययान् ॥

meaning.en: Those trees become his sons, there is no doubt; having gone to the other world he attains heaven and imperishable worlds.

verses.text:
पुष्पैः सुरगणान्वृक्षाः फलैश्चापि तथा पितॄन् ।
छायया चातिथींस्तात पूजयन्ति महीरुहाः ॥

meaning.en: With flowers trees honour the hosts of gods, with fruit the ancestors, and with shade the guests, dear one.

verses.text:
किंनरोरगरक्षांसि देवगन्धर्वमानवाः ।
तथा ऋषिगणाश्चैव संश्रयन्ति महीरुहान् ॥

meaning.en: Kinnaras, serpents, rakshasas, gods, gandharvas, humans and hosts of sages all take refuge in trees.

verses.text:
पुष्पिताः फलवन्तश्च तर्पयन्तीह मानवान् ।
वृक्षदं पुत्रवद्वृक्षास्तारयन्ति परत्र च ॥

meaning.en: Flowering and fruiting, they satisfy people here; trees save the giver of trees in the next world as sons would.

verses.text:
तस्मात्तडागे वृक्षा वै रोप्याः श्रेयोर्थिना सदा ।
पुत्रवत्परिपाल्याश्च पुत्रास्ते धर्मतः स्मृताः ॥

meaning.en: Therefore one seeking his good should always plant trees by a tank and tend them like sons; they are called his sons by dharma.

verses.text:
तडागकृद्वृक्षरोपी इष्टयज्ञश्च यो द्विजः ।
एते स्वर्गे महीयन्ते ये चान्ये सत्यवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: The maker of a tank, the planter of trees, the Brahmin who has performed sacrifices, and others who speak truth are honoured in heaven.

verses.text:
तस्मात्तडागं कुर्वीत आरामांश्चैव रोपयेत् ।
यजेच्च विविधैर्यज्ञैः सत्यं च सततं वदेत् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore one should make a tank, plant groves, perform various sacrifices and always speak the truth.
